items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: Snooky Young stood next to me on Louie Bellson’s band for a long time and he was also, we were in Bill Berry’s band together and also in the Juggernaut, Nat Pierce/Frank Capp band together.

ctx.x: Well for me, I was on Gerald’s band playing the lead chair for a while, and then Snooky Young stood next to me on Louie Bellson’s band for a long time and he was also, we were in Bill Berry’s band together and also in the Juggernaut, Nat Pierce/Frank Capp band together. I love Snooky. My three favorite lead trumpet players in the world are Snooky, Al Porcino and Conrad Gozzo. Anybody that’s going to learn to play lead trumpet better study those three guys because everybody else comes from those three. © Fillius…
